en: That's the couple from before. It looks like they're kicking up some kind of fuss in front of the hotel.
Trying to drag an unwilling girl off to a hotel is unforgivable. Especially when it's a minor.
There's a special place in hell for those who threaten innocent girls and try to force them into prostitution.
It'd be nice if that Kazumi-chan got to know Haruka-chan.
A cursed PrintCircle machine at Club SEGA, huh? Maybe I should check that out at some point.
That cursed PrintCircle machine at Club SEGA sounds like an urban legend, but maybe I'll take a pic as a memento.
So that's the ghost! He won't be getting away with that kind of mischief!
Who'd have thought the ghost was so average-looking? I guess I should go tell those high school girls at Club SEGA.
So the cursed PrintCircle machine was just a prank. Well, at least there wasn't any real harm done.
Apparently the guy I thought was the ghost died three years ago... Or was it just a chance resemblance?
He's in a fix. I feel like I should help out, and not just because I got a taste of his food on the house.
It seems like he's got some kind of idea. I'll come back later and see what's going on.
Miyu-chan must be exhausted, collapsing like that right after coming out of the convenience store. Is she really okay?
I'll make them pay dearly for tricking Miyu-chan!
I hope Miyu-chan cheers up again soon. I guess the least I can do is show up at her parlor whenever I can!
What kind of idiot shakes a kid down in a prominent place like this? Time to dish out a little discipline.
A million yen just for showing someone around Kineicho for the day? Maybe they're still on Kume Boulevard.
That guy is one of Daddy Papa's kidnappers! I'd better catch him and get him to spill their location.
Damn! A guy could get hurt at this rate! I'll have to give them a quick thrashing and save Daddy Papa.
A million Vietnamese dong? I've been cheated! Still, at least Daddy Papa didn't get hurt in the end.
I'm worried about that girl. I think I'd better follow her. She ran off towards the free info booth.
I found that girl in front of the free info booth. I'm a little worried, so I should see if she's okay.
I'll give these guys an ass-kicking for Misa-chan's sake!
I'm glad Misa-chan had second thoughts. There are some bad people out there.
That girl doesn't look like she's doing too hot. Maybe I should buy her an energy drink or something.
These guys are pure evil. They need to be taught a harsh lesson!
I'm glad those girls are all free now. I can't believe the things some people stoop to.
The manager of Strawberry on Tsumugi Street said he had a lead on a good job for me. Should I go check it out?
Relationships between fathers and sons are built on love and respect... Not this!
This is what I get for trying to get a proper job... So much for that idea.
It can't hurt to check out a new place, and it's cheap. If I can scrape up a spare 4,500 yen, I might try it out.
How come I'm the one getting yelled at here? I'm not giving up until I get my money back.
That barker needs to get his eyes checked. There's no way I want anything to do with either of those girls.
Doing it with Uno-san... Ugh, I don't think I'll recover from this anytime soon.
Doing it with Coach Fujita... Ugh, I don't think I'll recover from this anytime soon.
Mi-chan, huh? With a cutie like her around, I'd come to the batting center more often.
I wonder what Mi-chan's up to. Maybe I'll head down to the batting center and see.
How'd I end up having to buy her a bento lunch set? Well, I'd better bring it down to the batting center quick.
Mi-chan sure is cute. I don't think I'll be staying away from the batting center too long.
I guess I'll have to wait for that something special from Mi-chan. I'll practice my batting and have another crack at it.
A homemade lunch from Mi-chan? Talk about lucky! It was delicious, too. These challenges are great!
Dang. No chicken wings date yet. I'll have to practice my batting and try again.
So Mi-chan was working at a public bathhouse. That's a bit of a letdown, but I guess it's a good thing, right?
I'm glad I didn't mess that up. I am a journalist, after all.
I got the order for the novel text wrong. So much for my reputation as a journalist.
I got the order for the erotic memoir wrong. So much for my reputation as a journalist.
My reputation as a journalist is in tatters. I hope the editor-in-chief still gives me work...
I've got to bring Himoji some food, quick. He wanted whatever restores the most health for 500 yen or less.
I'm glad Himoji recovered. I guess the careful consideration paid off.
I'm glad Himoji recovered. I was a little worried about the food selection, but he seems happy enough.
I'm glad Himoji recovered. Still, I should probably have thought of something better.
That's the first time I've seen Seto-san in a while. I wonder if he's still at the north end of Kume Boulevard.
Kurashina ran off towards Mid Square. Maybe I should go after him.
I'll persuade these guys to tell me where Kurashina went.
Damn it, I'm surrounded. I have to find a way out of this and talk with Kurashina.
I guess this is why he's a promising rookie. But I'm not ready to lose to a youngster yet!
I'm glad everything worked out for Seto-san. I'll get him to treat me to a drink next time I see him!
First I have to find that idol Yamazaki.
I'll need to follow at the right distance⑬not too close, and not too far back.
Yamazaki met up with the girl he's cheating with. I guess I'll follow them a bit longer.
Damn it. I went to all that trouble only to lose sight of him. There goes my chance at some quick cash.
Damn it. I got spotted while I was following him. There goes my chance at some quick cash.
I managed to stay on his tail! Boy, this is tough work. That earned me some quick cash, though!
Someone's giving a speech over by the oval stage. They look a bit troubled. Maybe I'll go and say hi.
So the manager of Shachoko is getting into politics, huh? Hopefully he finds someone to do an endorsement speech.
I wonder if the Shachoko manager found someone to give a speech for him. He was over by the oval stage.
Hardly anyone paid any attention. I guess I let the manager down.
That seemed to go well. The manager has a lot more support than he thought.
Part time work at a convenience store, huh? I guess I could try that when I have some time.
I couldn't catch the shoplifter in the end. No way they'll let me take expired lunches home now.
I managed to catch that shoplifter. Maybe this means more expired lunches for me!
It's good to see someone taking an interest in baseball. I'll give him a few pointers when I get a chance.
That wasn't the greatest display of my ability. If I see him around again, I'll show him the proper way to do it.
Now it's up to him to follow through. I might come and see how he's doing later.
What's with that chicken? I guess I'll try to catch it and get the reward!
I didn't catch it myself, but I still got the reward. Cochin racing, huh? I might try it out when I get a chance.
I caught the chicken and received the reward! Cochin racing, huh? I might try it out when I get a chance.

During play, useful information required to progress through the game will appear as <Color:255, 200, 200, 255>Tips<Color:Default>. Press <Action:Button_Touchpad@Adventure> while Tips are displayed to see more detailed information. After Tips have disappeared, you can still view them from Memos in the Pause Menu.

You can view <Color:255, 200, 200, 255>Memos<Color:Default> from the Pause Menu, opened by pressing the <Action:Button_Options@Adventure> button. More items are added to Memos as you progress through the story and encounter more tips. When you need some help, look through Memos.

You can save the game at places where a Save Point marker appears, such as phone booths and hideouts. Saving records the current game status so you can continue the game from that point when you next play.

In certain situations, words such as "Talk" or "Leave" will appear on the top right, along with a button icon. These are called Action Icons. Press the indicated button to perform the action displayed.

The five main ways to recover health lost during battle are as follows.
 1. Consume food or drink at an eatery
 2. Relax at a hot spring or similar facility
 3. Eat food items
 4. Use recovery items such as Staminan X 
 5. Spend some time resting at a hideout
Remember to replenish your health when the situation calls for it.

At certain points throughout the game, you can switch which character you control at a hideout. Change characters either by speaking to the character you wish to change to, or by selecting them under "Select Character" in the Hideout menu.

When the main characters come together at New Serena, it becomes possible to switch between them. Your money, as well as points earned at casinos or the Coliseum, are pooled, along with items stored in the Item Box.
You can skip messages by holding down <Action:Button_R1@Adventure> and pressing <Action:Button_Cross@Adventure>. Use this when you want to end a conversation right away.
You can walk by holding down <Action:Button_R1@Adventure> as you move. Use <Action:Button_R3@Adventure> to enter first-person perspective mode.

The round map displayed on the lower left of the screen is called the minimap. It shows a map of your surroundings and also indicates your target destination and the position of enemies. The Map item on the Pause Menu, displayed by pressing the <Action:Button_Options@Adventure> button, shows an overview of the city or location you are currently in. This map also indicates stores and other areas of interest, so make good use of it to meet your objectives.

Your cell phone is used to receive messages from people you know, as well as useful information such as email newsletters. Messages are sorted by sender and time received, making it easy to find the email you want to read. You can also reply to some messages from hostesses, so be sure to check emails from your favorite girls and reply promptly.

Consumable items are single-use and have a variety of effects, from restoring health to sobering you up. Some items are not sold in stores, and others can only be exchanged for points. Be sure to keep some of the items available for purchase on hand, in case you need them in unexpected situations.

Most items that can be equipped are either weapons, gear, or accessories. These equipment items have no effect when kept in your inventory. Equip them in the right-hand column of the Item Menu to use or activate them. Note that some characters cannot equip certain weapons.

Some fashionable items will increase your likeability with hostesses when you wear them. You can obtain these items from a range of places, such as brand stores and pawn shops. If you don't get a favorable reaction to what you are wearing, try putting on some of these fashionable items before going to meet a hostess. They might see you in a new light.
